page_name: Page 6 — Data Quality and Analytical Reliability

labels.limitation: Quality evidence covers arithmetic and lineage only; licenses no behavioral, predictive, or causal reading.
labels.mirrored: Upstream checks are mirrored verbatim from frozen evidence — verified for parseability, counts, standing, and record completeness, not re-executed.

methodology: Eligibility means arithmetic/lineage fitness only (existence, parse, counts, PASS standing, exact row/hash identity) — not a business endorsement.
Mirrored checks were verified for parseability, counts, standing, and record completeness — not re-executed; the gate cannot detect errors the upstream validations themselves missed.
TOTAL verdict requires unanimity: any single failure aborts with no output (none occurred).
Counts and hashes are exact integers and full hex strings; no sampling, no tolerance on identity comparisons.
restrictions: mirrored evidence never reworded or re-executed
summarization off on all value fields
